question: Which of the following is a popular Thanksgiving festival of Meghalaya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chad Laho**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chad Laho** is a traditional festival celebrated by the Jaintia tribes of Meghalaya.
 
• It is a vibrant and colorful festival marking the end of the harvest season.
 
• The festival is characterized by dance, music, and community feasts, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of the Jaintia tribe.
 
• During Chad Laho, people don traditional attire and perform the famous 'Pynter' dance.
 
• The festival fosters community bonding and reinforces tribal traditions and values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Niamtre Religion**

 
 
• Niamtre is the indigenous religion followed by the Jaintia people.
 
• It involves the worship of natural elements like rivers, hills, and the sun.
 
• The religious practices include rituals, sacrifices, and festivals like Chad Laho.
 
 
 
• **Jaintia Hills**
 
 
• The Jaintia Hills are a part of the state of Meghalaya, known for their scenic beauty and rich cultural heritage.
 
• The region is inhabited by the Jaintia tribe, who have a distinct cultural and linguistic identity.
 
• Apart from Chad Laho, the region celebrates other festivals like Behdeinkhlam and Laho Dance Festival.
 
 
 
• **Meghalaya Harvest Festivals**
 
 
• Harvest festivals are significant in Meghalaya, celebrated by various tribes to mark the end of the agricultural season.
 
• Other notable harvest festivals include Wangala of the Garo tribe and Shad Suk Mynsiem of the Khasi tribe.
 
• These festivals involve traditional music, dance, and rituals, reflecting the agrarian lifestyle of the tribal communities.
